notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 : Return to teleporter
notes.content:
- Added a new menu option that teleport the player to the teleporter
- Fix various visual bug

notes.title: Patch 1.0.10 : Input and Undo
notes.content: - Prevent input buffering to place object into a beam just after an undo, making it the wrong gravity direction

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9 : Improve performance #1
notes.content:
- Remove particule effect that were not removed
- Improve particule effect performance
- Improve grey circle performance on some machines

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8 : Final level fix
notes.content: - Fix a visual bug and unintended way to do one of the final level

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7 : Undo & beam dessappearing
notes.content:
- Fix a bug where undo were save incorrectly when doing them rapidly
- Fix a bug that made gravity beam dissappear
- Fix a bug were block would swap when finishing a level

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 : Later level fix
notes.content:
- Fix couple unintended solution in later level
- Fix Final level 
- Fix bug with fusing mechanism
- Redesign 1 level in later area

notes.content:
- Fix a bug that cause statue to collide with the player while falling
- Prevent potential soft lock
- Fix unintended solutions

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 : soft lock fix

- Fix a way to soft lock yourself in an area

notes.title: LIGO is out now !
notes.content: It's finally here, I hope you enjoy the LIGO as much as I enjoy making it !

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
I’m excited to share that Ligo, my adventure puzzle game inspired, will officially launch on March 4, 2025!

Ligo is the culmination of three years of art, code, music, and game design From me (Anthony Berleur) and the talend Alex Russo and Gustavo Coutinho

whislist the game if you haven't !

And I can't wait for you to play the game.

[previewyoutube=cEmPinhne6E;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo Update and Cerebral showcase
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Just a quick announcement, as part of the Cerebral puzzle showcase There's a news demo available for you to try, the demo includes :

[list]
[*] New puzzles
[*] New sound design
[*] Full controller support
[*] Full steam deck support
[*] Level title
[*] some graphical improvements
[/list]

I'm also happy to announce that the game will release in 2024 so hang tight, you will soon be able to play the full game.

Thanks you !
